channel.title: Noty
channel.description: Sticky notes that live at the edge of your screen.

item.description:
Keep the lean on the tabs, sit the open note square

An open note is being read and written in, so a tilt fights the text. The tabs
are what should look stuck on by hand. The note also loses the edge bleed that
went with its lean and sits flush against the screen edge again.

Screenshots, demo and site rebuilt to match.
